params.style_image: upload of samples/art-diagnosis/knight-56-test.raw.png (96x96); usage 'Match this knight's design, colour palette, dark outline and shading style; the new figure is drawn larger than this reference, so do not copy its size.'
params.description: A large knight hero standing idle, facing the viewer (south), drawn big: the figure fills most of the canvas height, feet near the bottom edge. Silver steel plate armour with round pauldrons, closed great helm with a visor slit and a red feather plume on top, blue cloth tabard at the waist, a gold-rimmed blue kite shield with a gold cross held on his left arm (viewer's right), a steel sword held low in his right hand (viewer's left). Single dark outline, classic MMORPG game sprite, lit from the upper left, no background, no shadow.
